Maya: Hey @Priya — I just registered a civil partnership in the UK this week. Open enrollment was closed last month. Can I add my partner to medical/dental benefits mid‑year? What docs do you need and how long does it take? :wave:
Priya (People Ops): Congrats, Maya! :tada: Yes — that generally qualifies as a Qualifying Life Event (QLE). We can do a mid‑year enrollment as long as you submit within 30 days of the partnership date.
Maya: Awesome. What exactly counts as proof? I have the registered partnership certificate (PDF) and a UK driving licence. No SSN for them yet.
Priya (People Ops): The core items we need are: government‑issued partnership certificate (scanned PDF), proof of shared residence (utility bill or lease showing both names or shared address), and either a SSN/NI number or a signed declaration if they don't have an SSN yet. If they don’t have a US SSN, a UK National Insurance number is acceptable for initial enrollment, but payroll/benefits may need an SSN later for tax forms.
Maya: OK I'll upload the certificate and a joint tenancy agreement. Where do I upload?
Priya (People Ops): Please open a case in the Benefits portal: https://benefits.redwood.com/portal -> "Report a Life Event" and attach the docs. If you prefer, you can email benefits@redwood.com with subject line "QLE - partnership - Maya" and we’ll create the case for you.
Jake: FYI @Maya — for payroll, HSA/FSA pretax elections need to be updated before the next payroll cutoff to be effective for the upcoming pay period. People Ops will confirm effective dates after the docs are approved.
Maya: Good to know. Do I need to make plan selections in the portal, or will you auto‑enroll them in the same plans I have?
Priya (People Ops): After we validate the QLE docs, you'll get an email with a link to make plan elections (usually 14 days to complete). We don't auto‑enroll — you'll pick medical/dental/vision and dependent life. If you don't submit elections, we won't add them by default.
Arjun: Quick note — if the partner has other coverage, we might need proof of loss of coverage (if you're claiming special enrollment due to loss of other coverage). Not relevant if this is just adding after partnership.
Maya: Got it. I’ll gather cert + lease and submit today. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Benefits Bot: Reminder set — if no docs received within 7 days, People Ops will ping you for a follow-up.
Priya (People Ops): One more thing — for international partners we sometimes need notarized translations for non‑English certificates. If the UK certificate is in English you’re fine. If it's dated, we use the partnership date as the QLE date.
Maya: It's in English and the partnership date on the cert is 2026-02-15, so I'm within the 30‑day window. Submitting now. Thanks!
Priya (People Ops): Perfect — once you submit, DM me the case number and I'll fast‑track the review. :white_check_mark:
